description: This file defines the IVersionManager interface in C#, which provides methods for managing grain interface version negotiation strategies within the Orleans framework. It includes methods to set compatibility and selector strategies globally and for specific interface types.

classes.name: IVersionManager
classes.description: Interface for managing grain interface versioning strategies, including setting compatibility and selector strategies.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the global compatibility strategy for grain interface version negotiations.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the global selector strategy for grain interface version negotiations.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for a specific grain interface type.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the selector strategy for a specific grain interface type.
